# What's Now Playing Artifacts

Vendored release artifacts for `whatsnowplaying/whats-now-playing` pinned at `5.0.1`.

These files are included so VisualSynth releases can ship a known companion-tool bundle for
free DJ metadata capture workflows, especially Serato via a local metadata bridge.

Pinned hashes are recorded in [artifacts.json](/C:/Users/TimShelton/source/repos/VisualSynth/third_party/whats-now-playing/artifacts.json).
